recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中兩顆中性球的細胞核只分成兩葉，其中一顆呈兩個圓葉以細絲相連的眼鏡狀（pince-nez），另一顆呈花生或腎形，染色質粗糙團塊狀且細胞質顆粒偏少，符合假性Pelger-Huet細胞。
features: Two mature-sized neutrophils with hypolobated nuclei
Lower cell: bilobed nucleus with two round lobes joined by a thin strand (pince-nez or spectacle form)
Upper cell: nonsegmented peanut- to kidney-shaped nucleus
Coarsely clumped, mature chromatin inappropriate for a band form
Pale cytoplasm with sparse fine granules, suggesting hypogranularity
Background red cells with mild poikilocytosis including occasional target and teardrop forms
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils with hypolobated nuclei: one bilobed with two round lobes connected by a thin chromatin bridge (pince-nez form) and one with a nonsegmented peanut-shaped nucleus. Both nuclei have coarsely clumped mature chromatin, and the cytoplasm appears relatively hypogranular. The red cells show mild poikilocytosis. Findings are consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huet (acquired Pelger-Huet) neutrophils, which should prompt evaluation for myelodysplastic syndrome or a drug effect (e.g., mycophenolate, tacrolimus, valproate).

ddx.vs: The inherited anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation and no cytopenias, whereas acquired pseudo-Pelger cells are a subset often with hypogranulation and dysplasia in other lineages.
Band forms have a curved, uniformly thick horseshoe nucleus with less condensed chromatin, not two discrete round lobes with coarse clumped chromatin.
Immature myeloid cells have round or kidney-shaped nuclei with finer chromatin and more abundant specific granules.
